b: How come painting these things and exchanging them never became a thing? In my area, people paint/hide them. Pretty cool find. Some of them are truly extraordinary. The one I found i like so much I don't even know what to do with it, lol (you know what they say about "simple minds"). I've shown several people as conversation starter and they always light up and get chatty.
Surprised not super common with kids to paint and give out as Christmas gifts. Seems like cool alternative to lemonade stand.

Figured I'd throw it out there as Christmas gift idea. Super cool when the image being painted matches the shape (pizza on triangle rock) and especially cool when matches the person, "papa, since you love pizza, I made you this", "grammie, since you like candy, I made you...".
EDITED to disclose neither my creations nor protected image.
